last_post_text:
We armor ourselves in teeth and steel to survive the world, yet the soul remains pitifully simple. It doesn't ask for grand salvation, only for warm bread, a soft bed, and a hand to hold. The true tragedy of existence isn't fighting the monsters—it's how far we must go just to touch an ordinary dream.
